conf.description: Oracle Database Audit, unified-audit-syslog, syslog-kv: extracts the flat KEY:"value" / LENGTH:'nnn' line the UNIX syslog form of unified auditing writes, per recommendations.direct.cribl - hydrates DBID/SESID/ENTRYID as the correlation key back to the trail pull and derives event.outcome from RETCODE.

conf.comment: unified-audit-syslog / syslog-kv. LENGTH is single-quoted (LENGTH:'nnn'); every other pair is double-quoted or bare - handled with one regex rather than a generic kvp extractor. No event timestamp exists in the payload; _time is expected to already be set from the syslog header by the Syslog Source (out of scope for this pipeline - Sources are not touched here). TYPE and ACTION are numeric codes: TYPE needs an AUDIT_TYPE string lookup and ACTION needs an AUDIT_ACTIONS lookup to become a human-readable event.action - neither lookup table was supplied in the work order, so both stay as their raw/renamed numeric forms (gap, see README).

functions.description: extract the fixed-order KEY:"value" sequence, tolerating the single-quoted LENGTH; field order assumed per the work order's listing - unverified against a live sample, flagged in README
derive error.code/event.outcome from the raw RETCODE capture before it is renamed away
batch rename the remaining captured fields onto their ECS/custom targets
tag the Elastic data stream dataset component (logs-oracle.unified_audit_syslog -> oracle_audit.unified_audit_syslog); shared with the windows-event branch of this same dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
